title: Activation-sensitivity profiling and INT8 runtime fallbacks for activation-aware quantization
creator: Aisha Kaplan
description: Goal: Implement an activation-sensitivity profiling pipeline and runtime kernel fallback strategy to make activation-aware INT8 quantization (SmoothQuant-style) safe and observable for production workloads. Deliverables: (1) offline profiling tool that computes per-layer activation/gain sensitivity and outputs canonical quant profiles (scale, channel-wise flags, fallback hints), (2) calibration harness that integrates with our existing eval/e2e accuracy runner and produces paired token-level diffs and A/B metrics, (3) runtime kernel adaptor that accepts profile hints from the model metadata and can dynamically route layers to: per-channel INT8 kernels, quantization-compensated fused kernels, or FP16/FP32 fallback when activations exceed configured thresholds, and (4) dashboarding hooks and rollout policy flags so we can safely enable profiles via canary and automatic rollback on quality regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Profiling tool can ingest a model + 1k representative inferences and emit a JSON profile with per-layer sensitivity scores and recommended quant modes
Calibration harness produces accuracy numbers (perplexity / task metric) vs baseline and a diff report that surfaces top 10 layers contributing to accuracy loss
Runtime can read profile metadata at model load time and route kernels without requiring a model redeploy; routing latency < 0.8ms per-inference warmup on p4d-like hardware
Automated rollout: enable profile for 10% of traffic, monitor quality metric in Console; if regression > 1.5% for 5 mins, automatically rollback to previous kernel policy
E2E test coverage: unit tests for profile JSON parsing, integration tests for fallback routing, and nightly accuracy regression test runs included in CI
tasks: Design JSON schema for activation sensitivity profile and compatibility flags (owner: Mateo)
Build offline profiler CLI that collects activation histograms, second moment, and per-channel gain ratios (owner: ML ops)
Extend calibration harness to run short A/B evals and produce token-diff reports (owner: Eval team)
Implement runtime kernel adaptor with three routing modes (per-channel-int8, compensated-fused-int8, fp16-fallback) (owner: runtime)
Add Console telemetry hooks: per-model profile accepted, route-miss rates, accuracy deltas (owner: Console)
Create canary rollout plan and a small customer-facing doc for QA and Solutions (owner: SE)
Performance microbenchmarks and kernel selection thresholds tuning (owner: perf eng)
Integrate profile storage into model-catalog with version compatibility checks (owner: infra)
Ship PRs and request design/PM reviews, iterate on feedback (owner: all)
Post-launch: collect 2 weeks of canary metrics and propose default thresholds for runtime fallback (owner: analytics)

notes: Trade-offs: aggressive per-channel INT8 reduces cost but increases code-path permutations and kernel maintenance. Fallback to fp16 keeps accuracy but reduces savings; we intend to make fallback thresholds conservative initially. We need to coordinate with kernel team for fused ops (attention + linear) to implement compensated kernels that preserve KV-cache semantics. Link to PRD: https://drive.redwood.com/prd/activation-profiles.pdf
